steps.content: [Phanuel's Mansion]

21:40, July 10, N.F. 116
Luxury Penthouse, Eastside

steps.speaker: Television
steps.content: All the hottest scoops, all the latest buzz, right here, right now! Welcome to today's show! We've got Eastside's biggest star in the studio. Everyone, it's Phanuel!

steps.speaker: Television
steps.content: Come say hello to our audience!

steps.speaker: Television
steps.content: Hi everyone! I'm Phanuel. Very happy to be here today!

steps.speaker: Television
steps.content: And there it is, that smile. The one that's been melting hearts across the entire internet. You know, I still remember my first interview with you earlier this year. You were so shy back then. A little nervous in front of the camera.

steps.speaker: Television
steps.content: Shy? ...Yes. I think I was told to act that way.

steps.speaker: Television
steps.content: ...Ha! Such a sense of humor! Clearly, you've mastered the talk show circuit now. So tell us, since your debut, what would you say has changed the most about you?

steps.speaker: Television
steps.content: Nothing has changed. Phanuel has always, always... been a good girl.

steps.speaker: Television
steps.content: Such a unique take, as always! But I'm sure your fans would say the upcoming concert is the biggest milestone yet. A real sign of how far you've come. Wouldn't you agree?

steps.speaker: Television
steps.content: The concert...

steps.speaker: Television
steps.content: Yes! All of Eastside is watching. The anticipation is off the charts. How long have you been preparing for this, Phanuel?

steps.speaker: Television
steps.content: I've been preparing for... wait. Let me think. Was it three months, or... I'm not really sure.

steps.speaker: Television
steps.content: Haha, that's what happens when your schedule's packed solid! Everything blurs together. Anything stand out from the prep? Any memorable moments?

steps.speaker: Television
steps.content: Every day, someone tells me when to wake up. When to eat. When to rehearse. When to do interviews. And what to say during them.

steps.speaker: Television
steps.content: This morning, I woke up, and my clothes were already laid out at the foot of the bed. Even my socks were arranged in order. I never thought that was a problem before.

steps.speaker: Television
steps.content: Sounds like a well-oiled machine of a team! A celebrity's life does need that kind of support. We're running short on time. Any final words for your Cherubs out there? ...Phanuel?

steps.speaker: Television
steps.content: Do you... like balloons? They wear colorful little outfits, and they float up so, so high, and then... BANG!!!

steps.speaker: Television
steps.content: We'll, uh, we'll be right back after this short video break!
Click. The remote kills the program.

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: The producer is not happy with you. Fortunately, it wasn't live. The raw footage is in my hands. No one else will see it.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Mm.

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: Do you remember the point of this interview?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Promote the concert and the new single. Appear warm and relatable. Share cute little moments from my daily life. Express curiosity about school to attract a younger audience.

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: And did you do that?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: No.

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: ...Why?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: School... I don't remember anything about it. Phanuel was born to be a star on stage, an idol who everyone loves. I tried to connect the two, school and stardom, but there's nothing there.

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: Oh, you're all grown up now. Using my own words against me.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: No.
Eliza flings the remote to the floor, crosses her arms, and takes a deep, steadying breath.

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: I can see <color=#fb9259>that person</color> has been getting to you.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: I'm sorry. This was my fault entirely. I've let you down. I've failed the <color=#fb9259>company</color> that made me. And I've failed my fans...

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: Enough. I've already smoothed things over with the producer. Your segments will be cut. The official line is concert prep—grueling schedule, exhaustion, doctor's orders. You were too unwell to appear.

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: You'll film some behind-the-scenes footage with them later, of you looking pale and frail. I'll handle the medical paperwork and the prescription records. We'll post the apology together. It'll play well. Sympathy, concern, a little pre-concert buzz...

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Understood. Phanuel will face the days ahead with strength and bring love and courage to all my Cherubs.
Eliza studies the face before her with sharp, appraising eyes. Then, just as quickly, the tension drains from her shoulders.

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: What's done is done. I'm not going to hold this over you. A face that pretty shouldn't go to waste. Everyone goes crazy for that smile of yours. Keep giving it to them.

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: Do you know what's next?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Yes. It's ten o'clock. Time for dance practice.
In the cavernous, empty penthouse, the speakers pump out the special new track Phanuel has prepared for her concert.

Beneath the music and the beat, a faint rustle of fabric stirs from the far end of the walk-in closet. Someone lies bound at the wrists and ankles, struggling to inch forward. Sweat drips from the person's brow into the carpet, leaving a broken trail of dark stains.
Half the song later, he finally reaches the door. His bound hands fumble blindly behind his back, feeling through the narrow gap until they push it open, letting in a sliver of light.
steps.female_content: Half the song later, she finally reaches the door. Her bound hands fumble blindly behind her back, feeling through the narrow gap until they push it open, letting in a sliver of light.

steps.content: [Falling SFX][Small CG: Peeping POV Projection]

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: One, two, three, four. Two, two, three, four...
Something flickers at the edge of Phanuel's vision. She falters mid-step, her rhythm breaking.

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: Wrong. Start over.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Two two three four...
Her dance shoes clack against the marble floor, struggling to keep up with the beat.
The figure in the shadows shrinks back further, using the cover to keep watching. Eliza notices but merely smirks and turns to Phanuel:

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: From now on, you focus only on the concert. Everything we've built, all of it, has been leading to that moment. That's when you shine brightest. That's when you become what you were always meant to be. You will be the star that commands all eyes.

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: Whatever <color=#fb9259>that person</color> did, or said to you, it changes nothing. You were born for the spotlight. Nothing can take that from you.
Phanuel raises her head. A perfect, polished smile stretches across her face, but behind it, her eyes grow increasingly hollow.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: I was born for the spotlight...

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: I will command all eyes...
She keeps dancing. It's not even that hard of a practice. Still, her voice comes out thin and hollow.

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: Forget it. Whatever happened while I was away no longer matters. You’ve already seen what became of that person.
The figure writhes inside the closet. The faint sounds of the struggle are swallowed entirely by the music.
Nngh...
Phanuel's consciousness begins to blur. She thinks she sees someone in the shadows trying to catch her attention, but her awareness is already slipping out of her control.

steps.speaker: Eliza
steps.content: Don't worry. We're a management company, not criminals. Once everything is finished, I'll let him go. Even if you can't see it now, everything I do is for you. For what we're building together.
steps.female_content: Don't worry. We're a management company, not criminals. Once everything is finished, I'll let her go. Even if you can't see it now, everything I do is for you. For what we're building together.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Phanuel understands... this is the company's order.

steps.speaker: Eliza & Phanuel
steps.content: Yes. Let them worship you, let them give their faith to you. Guide them, liberate them... Yes. Let them worship me, let them give their faith to me. Guide them, liberate them...
An eerie fragrance seeps through the air, steadily infiltrating Phanuel's senses.
[Big CG: Close-up]

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Yes. Phanuel will become everything you've ever wanted. The brightest star Eastside has ever seen.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: The virtual angel will step into the real world for the very first time. A stage of light. A path to paradise. She'll lead her faithful there, all of them.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Come and find happiness with Phanuel!
Deep into the night, the office is empty and still. The whole floor sits in darkness, the lights long dead, except for the monitor on Tracy's desk still burning bright.
On the screen, an exclusive video plays, a special perk reserved for loyal Cherubs.

steps.speaker: Phanuel?
steps.content: Come and find happiness with Phanuel!

steps.speaker: Phanuel?
steps.content: C-C-C-COME AND—*A(&SYH@%$— FIND HAPPINESS HAP-HAP-HAP-HAPPINESS WITH PHANUEL?
[Small CG 2: Close-up of Face, Screen Reflected in Eyes]
On the screen, Phanuel fractures into dozens of misaligned windows—her smile, her eyes, her fingers, the hem of her skirt—all flickering in jagged, out-of-sync flashes, mirrored in Tracy's pupils.
The pink-white static begins to bleed past the edges of the frame, layering over countless smiling faces, inching closer... devouring what little remains of Tracy's awareness.

steps.speaker: Tracy
steps.content: Yes... I will go find happiness... with Phanuel...
